name: Pattern(s) with reference stick rows per phase
use_case: Measured pattern above one row of reference positions per phase. The positions come from your peak list or reference file.

data_roles.sticks: phase name + position from a second table (a peak list); none in the file = no rows

origin_hint: Origin: line plot + one scatter layer per phase with vertical-bar symbols (Plot Details > Symbol).
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
